Advertising is about to land on Apple Maps in the US and Canada, with businesses able to start booking ads from today. Here's what you need to know, including a limited-time promotional offer for merchants.

Businesses can now book Apple Maps ads starting today

If you own a business and want to advertise on Apple Maps, the booking service officially launched today.

Although users won't see the ads go live just yet, Apple is preparing for a full rollout and has now opened up ad bookings to merchants.

Full details on ad bookings have been published on Apple's website, including how to get started.

Apple has also rolled out a special limited-time offer, details as follows:

The offer applies to eligible merchants who book and pay for Maps ads by credit card on or before October 11, 2026.

As previously noted earlier this year, ads will appear in two places on Apple Maps:

  • Before a user searches: A "Suggested Places" listing will display a business ad on the search page.
  • After a user searches: Ads will appear in search results when those results are relevant to the search.

If you're considering advertising on Apple Maps, Apple also has a dedicated page outlining its advertising policies, available here.

Apple says its Maps service sees more than one billion business-related searches per month, and that one in every two business searches leads to an action. Additionally, according to the Q1 2025 GWI Core Study, Gen Z and Millennials make up 57% of Apple Maps users.
